messages:
Priya: Heads up — planning to onboard lumen-7b into the model catalog tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need volunteers for the canary smoke + rollback readiness. Plan: pin lumen-7b@v1.2.0 to the catalog entry 'lumen-7b', run a 10 rps canary for 15m in us-west1, then promote. Questions: who can own smoke runs? Any timing conflicts? Fallback: pin back to lumen-7b@v1.1.5 and scale down instances. cc @Ana @Chris @Devon

Ana: I can take the smoke run. Will be available 09:20–10:30 PT. I'll run perf smoke and basic coherence checks.

Chris: I'll watch infra and the GPU pool. If we see >10% tail latency bump we abort. Who will trigger the pin?

Priya: @Ana please trigger the pin via catalog UI or CLI. CLI: `rwd catalog pin --model lumen-7b --version v1.2.0 --env prod-canary --reason "onboard smoke"`

Ana: noted. What's the smoke checklist?

Priya: minimal smoke: 1) 200 chat completion samples @various lengths; 2) 50 embedding calls; 3) latency P95 < 200ms on an 8k-token mix; 4) no new tokenization regressions. I'll paste command snippets.

Priya: ```# perf harness
rwd smoke run --model lumen-7b@v1.2.0 --samples ./smoke/quick_set.json --concurrency 10 --timeout 300
# pin via api
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/catalog/pin -d '{"model":"lumen-7b","version":"v1.2.0","env":"prod-canary"}'
```

Devon: I'll keep an eye on logs/traces and KV cache usage. Set alert if cache hit rate drops >15%.

Maya: I'll be on-call for the rollout window and can handle rollback pin if needed. Ping me on the call channel. Also we should update the model docs page with quantization notes.

Ana: Starting pin in 5 mins. Will run harness and post summary.

deploy-bot: catalog-service: pin request accepted for lumen-7b@v1.2.0 by Ana at 1800345705. Canary env: prod-canary. Canary id: can-2034

Ana: harness started. Quick sample: 200 chats in 3m, P95=180ms, errors=0. Posting full logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/legacy/1234

Chris: infra looks stable, GPU util +8%, no pod OOMs.

Devon: KV cache hit 82% -> stable. No regressions flagged by tokenization smoke.

Maya: :thumbsup: If anything goes sideways, rollback plan: `rwd catalog pin --model lumen-7b --version v1.1.5 --env prod-canary` && `./ops/autoscale-down.sh`

Ana: finishing final checks, will promote to prod after 15m if no regressions.

Priya: Thanks all. Please drop a short follow-up when promoted. I'll update release notes.
